gen-fs-nippo-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads approachably, with clipped capitals and ascenders and wide-set terminals on the s. Nippo is best at wire-cut, outlined letterforms with proud small letters, while the body font simply gets on with being easy to follow.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mo: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters far apart, with open counters that breathe into the white space. And Nippo, cut from wire with small letters standing nearly capital-tall, gives that spacing a crisp, technical frame to sit under.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-biryani: Biryani is a sans-serif with a large, clear eye on every e.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-blinker: Blinker's lines hold their thickness and its apertures stay open.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-carrois-gothic: Nippo draws its letters like bent wire, with no hairline-to-stem shift and small letters nearly capital-sized. Carrois Gothic, a plain sans, matches that.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Contemporary through and through, this pair puts Nippo over Carrois Gothic SC.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-cascadia-code: Nippo's strokes look cut from wire.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-cascadia-mono: Modern and a touch businesslike, Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with visible daylight through every curve of the letters.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Compact, wiry and modern, Nippo leads with proud small letters. And Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut.
